title: How to Build an Employee Onboarding App With AI (No HR Software Subscription Required)
summary: Build a custom employee onboarding app with AI — welcome portal, task checklists, document signing, and manager dashboards. No $400/mo BambooHR subscription required. → blink.new
body_markdown: For teams under 50 employees, a custom app often fits better — it matches your actual workflow instead of adapting your process to a template built for a 500-person company. BambooHR is genuinely well-suited for larger organizations using its full HR, payroll, and benefits stack. But if you're paying $400–$600/month and actively using 20% of the features, a custom onboarding app that does exactly what you need is worth building. The SaaS subscription tax compounds every year.
